plainSummary: Progress counts all required completion tasks, so passing checks cannot make unfinished work appear complete.

Inspected all four final screenshots: desktop and mobile show 5/22 completion tasks (22%) alongside 4/4 verified checks; Overview agrees; previously completed work shows current readiness and an explicit rechecking notice. Current visual evidence gate passes. Reviewed audit addition preserving prior judgments and provenance; independently ran the inventory check for 54 criteria in eight workstreams.
